about: Passages still to check: where Scripture may explain a name but the list has no entry yet. Each gives the naming verse, the verse with the reason (often the one before or after), and a note. tools/coverage.py marks which are already in data/explanations.json.

candidates.name: Beer-lahai-roi
candidates.note: the well named after Hagar's words, 'Thou God seest me'

candidates.name: Jehovah-jireh
candidates.note: 'In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen'

candidates.name: Isaac
candidates.why: A play on the name (Abraham laughs), with no stated reason; Isaac is explained at Gen 21:6.

candidates.name: Mizpah
candidates.note: 'The LORD watch between me and thee'

candidates.name: Jehovah-nissi
candidates.note: the altar named; reason in the next verse

candidates.name: Taberah
candidates.note: 'because the fire of the LORD burnt among them'

candidates.name: Kibroth-hattaavah
candidates.note: 'because there they buried the people that lusted'

candidates.name: En-hakkore
candidates.note: the spring of him that called

candidates.name: Perez-uzzah
candidates.note: the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah

candidates.name: Absalom's place
candidates.note: 'I have no son to keep my name in remembrance'

candidates.name: Solomon
candidates.note: 'his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace'

candidates.name: Eliezer
candidates.note: 'the God of my father was mine help'

candidates.name: Bethel
candidates.note: 'this is none other but the house of God' (two verses earlier)

candidates.name: Penuel
candidates.note: 'for I have seen God face to face'

candidates.name: Corban
candidates.why: A term glossed, not a name.

candidates.name: Allon-bachuth
candidates.note: the event is told (Deborah buried under an oak); the weeping in the name is implied, not stated.
candidates.why: A one-off name, explained in the verse that names it, and only implied: little value for readers (EJ, 2026-10-23).

candidates.name: Ramath-lehi
candidates.note: the reason is the act (he threw away the jawbone), not a "for" clause.
candidates.why: A one-off name, explained in the verse that names it, and only implied: little value for readers (EJ, 2026-10-23).

candidates.name: Mahaneh-dan
candidates.note: the reason is the camp itself ("pitched in Kirjath-jearim").
candidates.why: A one-off name, explained in the verse that names it, and only implied: little value for readers (EJ, 2026-10-23).

candidates.name: Sela-hammahlekoth
candidates.note: the event is told (Saul turns back); the "divisions" or "escape" in the name is implied.
candidates.why: A one-off name, explained in the verse that names it, and only implied: little value for readers (EJ, 2026-10-23).

candidates.name: Cabul
candidates.note: Hiram's complaint is the reason; the meaning of Cabul ("as nothing"?) is implied, not stated.
candidates.why: A one-off name, explained in the verse that names it, and only implied: little value for readers (EJ, 2026-10-23).

candidates.name: Bamah
candidates.note: a wordplay on "high place" (bamah) and "ye go" (ba'im); the explanation is God's question.
candidates.why: A one-off name, explained in the verse that names it, and only implied: little value for readers (EJ, 2026-10-23).

candidates.name: Elymas
candidates.note: "for so is his name by interpretation" glosses Elymas as "the sorcerer"; commentators debate how the two names relate.
candidates.why: A one-off name, explained in the verse that names it, and only implied: little value for readers (EJ, 2026-10-23).
